key_naming: sb = StatsBomb side, wy = Wyscout/Pappalardo side, as one _-separated part of a key that concerns one provider; no key at any depth of this file, of descriptor_test_vectors.json, of synthetic_gate.json or of results.json contains statsbomb, pappalardo or wyscout in any letter case or starts with SB_ (tests/test_licensing.py reads the keys of every JSON file under experiments/ for the first and the prefix; the runner test of PIPELINE section 9 for all three)
verified_by_root_before_registration: pipeline_spec_sha256: lf_sha256 of PIPELINE.md as registered
descriptor_fingerprints and descriptor_fingerprints_sb: recomputed from the payloads of descriptor_test_vectors.json

dismissal_check assumption (ROOT 2.9 Z2): a structure-only count, run by the root on the corpus before registration and computing no outcome, per league, of the players whose event record carries a second_yellow card and of those among them whose sheet red_minute in that match is not null, its counts and share per league recorded in the registration commit; the assumption holds when that share is at least dismissal_assumption_minimum_share in every league; otherwise dismissal_check_fallback replaces dismissal_check before registration and the draft is audited again

dismissal_check residuals: the same structure-only count of players with a dismissal card in the event record and a null sheet red_minute, and of the reverse, per league, is stated in the registration commit; these are the matches dismissals_mismatch is built to invalidate, and only G1 bounds them

reliability_split calendar count (third audit, 2-1): a structure-only count on the match calendars, run by the root before registration and computing no outcome, per league and for each half of reliability_split, the distribution over teams of the share of the half's meetings dated before evaluation_start and of the half's home meetings; recorded in the registration commit; it changes nothing in the rule
state_change_rule: an incident changes the state of events with a strictly later (period, seconds)
goal_incident_rule: a row whose sidecar own_goal is true is a goal of the other team of the match; otherwise a row whose sidecar goal_on_scoring_event is true is a goal of the acting team; regulation periods only

dismissal_check.rule: per team and match, the number of distinct players with a regulation event whose sidecar card is in dismissal_cards equals the number of the team's sheet players whose red_minute is not null; otherwise the match is invalid (dismissals_mismatch)

dismissal_check_fallback: used only if the assumption check fails: per team and match, the number of distinct players with a regulation event whose sidecar card is red_card equals the number of the team's sheet players whose red_minute is not null and who carry no second_yellow event in that match; a second_yellow event still closes the window but is not compared with the sheet
validity_scope: once per match, for every window and every model
fraction_rule: a cut the config gives as [n, d] is the float64 quotient n/d, compared with float64 coordinates
lateral_edge_rule: y < 1/3 is the acting team's left; y > 2/3 is its right; 1/3 <= y <= 2/3 is centre
fingerprint_rule: first 16 hex characters of sha256 over the UTF-8 payload string of PIPELINE.md section 3.6
not_run_in_this_experiment: regain height or any quantity needing a possession segmentation rule
any shot quantity weighted by a conversion model
peers_level_rule: B3 level mean = e lam_v rA_c rD_peers, rD_peers = (sum_g O_g + kD') / (sum_g E_g + kD') over the unit's league-tercile peers g != u, with O_g and E_g as in rD_g; rD_peers = 1 under context_only
raw_persistence_level_rule: B5 level mean = e (Y5 + s) / (X5 + s / lam), Y5 and X5 the unit's conceded events and exposure over its last raw_persistence_matches valid rows, lam the league rate over both venues, s = log_ratio_smoothing_per_part
selection_tie_rule: the tie set is every candidate whose pooled loss is at most the smallest pooled loss plus selection_tie_tolerance; context_only if it is in the set, else the largest value in the set
selection_scope: eligible development rows, all five leagues pooled, ratio of sums
level_selection_rule: kA' on the pooled B1 deviance over shrinkage_grid; with kA' fixed, kD' on the pooled B2 deviance over shrinkage_grid and context_only (rD = 1); same tie rule
evaluation_events_rule: the subject's sum of N over eligible evaluation rows of the league
world_cluster: (league, calendar week W-SUN of the match date); label f'{league}|{part}|{week}' with week = str(pd.Timestamp(date).to_period(calendar_week_rule)) and part 'development' or 'evaluation'
world_strata: league x part, leagues in the order of the leagues the run passes (leagues, or replication.leagues), development before evaluation; a part holds the weeks of rows dated in it, and a part with no rows has no stratum
world_draw: per stratum of m clusters, rng.integers(0, m, size=(bootstrap_replicates, m)) counted into multiplicities; one generator for every stratum, in stratum order
donor_seed_rule: int.from_bytes(sha256(f'{seed}|{placebo_seed}|{league}|{date:%Y-%m-%d}|{tercile}'.encode('utf-8')).digest()[:8], 'big'), date the normalised pandas Timestamp of the decision date, tercile the 0-based int
permutation_strata: league x strength tercile at the decision date
strength_tercile_source: the match sheet, every prior match, valid or not
p_value_rule: (1 + number of replicates >= -zero_tolerance) / (replicates with a non-zero denominator + 1)
holm_order_rule: ascending p; None and NaN after every number and never rejected; ties in the order of secondary_descriptors; m is holm_family_size always
reliability_split: each half holds one meeting with each opponent: the team's meetings with an opponent are its rows against it, valid or not, the earlier and the later by (date, game_id); opponents are ordered by the date of the earlier meeting, then team id; for an opponent at a position (0-based) of 0 or 1 modulo 4 half A takes the earlier meeting, at 2 or 3 modulo 4 the later meeting; half B takes the other; a team with one meeting against an opponent has no later meeting; an invalid meeting is in neither half and is not replaced
reliability_centring: league mean removed within each half
persistence_rule: T1: per coordinate, the correlation over teams of the league-centred development-part value with the league-centred evaluation-part value, each from the pooled counts of the team's valid rows dated in that part (log_ratio_smoothing_per_part per part), teams with at least minimum_half_matches_per_team valid rows in each part; no step-up

strength_confound_reasoning.descriptor: the claim of a descriptor is a property of the defending team beyond its measured strength (ROOT 2.2: more than team strength or schedule), so shared variance with points, goals and pass share is what the claim must exclude
strength_confound_reasoning.level: how many entries a team concedes is partly its strength by construction; the level claim is beyond the attacking team's volume, not beyond strength, and its sentence says the two are not separated

strength_survival_tails: both: for each coordinate, discriminant_validity with the frozen thresholds, top_k and ties is called on the league-centred coordinate and on its negation, with the same covariates; the coordinate passes when both calls pass

descriptor: a, b, c, d, e, f and g all true
a, b, c or f not true
level: La, Lb and Le all true

registry_common.not_run_statement: E-10 is registered and not run. Nothing has been compared.

registry_non_claims.conceded: This is where the opponent's actions were recorded. A team can leave a channel open on purpose. Event data cannot tell that apart from failing to close it, so this panel does not say the team defends that channel badly.
registry_non_claims.own_actions: This is where the team's defensive actions were recorded. Actions happen where the ball is, so this follows the opponent's play as well as the team's choices. It does not show where the team's defensive line stands and does not say how well the team defends.
registry_non_claims.level: This counts the opponent's final-third entry passes that were recorded. Conceding them can be a choice as well as a failure, and event data cannot tell the two apart, so this panel does not say how well the team defends.

registry_descriptor.scope: Teams of the five leagues of the public Pappalardo/Wyscout corpus, 2017/18; one row per team and match, first and second half, before any dismissal, goal difference at most one; the defending team's history against the attacking team's own history.

registry_level.scope: Teams of the five leagues of the public Pappalardo/Wyscout corpus, 2017/18; one row per team and match, first and second half, before any dismissal, goal difference at most one; final-third entry passes conceded per 90 minutes of that window.

DEFENDER_SHAPE_SIGNAL.statement: On later matches of one season from one provider, the defending team's own history accounted for part of this split beyond the attacking team's own history, and the split passed the frozen checks that it repeats across two halves of the team's matches that each hold one meeting with every opponent and is more than team strength measured by points, goals and pass share. The estimate is shrunken toward the league composition, describes match states before any dismissal and within one goal, and was decided on matches of the whole season.

ADDED_INFORMATION_NOT_SHOWN.statement: E-10 compared this split with what the attacking team's own history accounts for, on later matches, and the defending team's own history did not meet every frozen criterion for adding to it. Read it as a record of past matches, not as a tendency.

SIDE_NOT_SHOWN.statement: On later matches the defending team's own history added to what the attacking team's own history accounts for in this split, but it was not shown to tell the team's left from its right. Read it as a record of past matches, not as a tendency.

NOT_RELIABLE.statement: On later matches the defending team's own history added to what the attacking team's own history accounts for in this split, but the split did not pass the frozen check that it repeats across two halves of the team's matches that each hold one meeting with every opponent. Read it as a record of past matches, not as a tendency.

STRENGTH_NOT_EXCLUDED.statement: On later matches the defending team's own history added to what the attacking team's own history accounts for in this split, and the split passed the frozen check that it repeats across two halves of the team's matches that each hold one meeting with every opponent, but it did not pass the frozen check that it is more than team strength measured by points, goals and pass share. Read it as a record of past matches, not as a tendency.

INCONCLUSIVE.statement: E-10 could not test this descriptor: a frozen gate failed before any evaluation loss was aggregated. No evaluation result was compared.

LEVEL_ESTABLISHED.statement: On later matches of one season from one provider, the defending team's own history accounted for part of how many final-third entry passes it conceded beyond the attacking team's own volume, and the volume passed the frozen check that it repeats across two halves of the team's matches that each hold one meeting with every opponent. This check does not separate it from team strength. It was decided on matches of the whole season.

ADDED_INFORMATION_NOT_SHOWN.statement: E-10 compared how many final-third entry passes teams conceded with what the attacking team's own volume accounts for, on later matches, and the defending team's own history did not meet every frozen criterion for adding to it. Read it as a record of past matches.

NOT_RELIABLE.statement: On later matches the defending team's own history added to what the attacking team's own volume accounts for, but the volume did not pass the frozen check that it repeats across two halves of the team's matches that each hold one meeting with every opponent. Read it as a record of past matches.

INCONCLUSIVE.statement: E-10 could not test this volume: a frozen gate failed before any evaluation loss was aggregated. No evaluation result was compared.

descriptor.sentence: Pseudo-events by which the attacking team's composition is drawn toward the league composition, selected on development matches.
Pseudo-events by which the defending team's own deviation is drawn toward zero, selected on development matches.
Lower bound of the split-half reliability, the smallest over the coordinates; a point is shown only at 0.70 or above.

level.sentence: Pseudo-events by which the attacking team's volume ratio is drawn toward one, selected on development matches.
Pseudo-events by which the defending team's own volume ratio is drawn toward one, selected on development matches.
Lower bound of the split-half reliability of the volume; a point is shown only at 0.70 or above.

product_rules.proposal_sentence_rule: keyed on the cited record's may_gate: may_gate true needs no sentence; otherwise proposal_sentence_not_tested when the record is not registered, PENDING or INCONCLUSIVE, and proposal_sentence_not_established when its status is NOT_ESTABLISHED; a proposal that cites several E-10 records carries one qualifier per cited record whose may_gate is false, each beside that record's label, in the order of subject_groups, none merged or dropped
product_rules.proposal_sentence_not_tested: based on a record E-10 has not tested
product_rules.proposal_sentence_not_established: based on a record that did not pass E-10
product_rules.planning_research_sentence: E-10 asked whether a defending team's own history adds information about what it concedes and where its defensive actions are recorded; each E-10 record listed here says whether that was tested for its quantity. That is not validity or decision use, and no quantity on this page is an E-10 descriptor.
product_rules.s5_ratio_name: opponent passes per recorded high-zone defensive action
product_rules.s5_panel_rule: the S5 panel shows the share under its label; s5_ratio_name names, in prose only, the ratio the share is a monotone transform of; no panel shows or labels the ratio

replication.retuning: none: kA and kD are those selected on the Pappalardo development rows

sb_team_sheet_arguments.note: read_team_sheets requires them; E-10 reads only its dismissed column; the values are E-11's

replication.gate_rule: G1 with this block's minimum_valid_match_share_per_league, the valid share being valid matches over the matches the folder's index lists (a listed match whose files are absent has no row and counts as invalid; the listed count reaches evaluate_replication as listed_matches); G3 with this block's minimum_evaluation_rows_per_league, minimum_evaluation_weeks_per_league and minimum_evaluation_events_per_league; no G2, G4, G5 or G6
replication.estimand_rule: B4, the candidate and B6 only, with the frozen kA and kD, on every eligible row of the season; no selection, no placebo, and no R1, V1, P2, T1 or I1

inconclusive_reason_rules.DATA_MISSING: any folder of leagues, or its match index, is absent; checked for existence before any file is read; applies to every comparable descriptor
inconclusive_reason_rules.VOCABULARY: a pass type, shot type or card name outside sb_known_pass_types, sb_known_shot_types or sb_known_card_names
inconclusive_reason_rules.SAMPLE: a league fails G1 or G3 of gate_rule, or a folder's index lists a number of matches other than expected_matches; a listed match without its files is an invalid match
inconclusive_reason_rules.FAILED_RUN: an exception inside the replication stage, a malformed timestamp included (the reader raises on it)

replication.status_rule: the first that holds: NOT_COMPARABLE, NOT_RUN, REPLICATION_INCONCLUSIVE with the first reason that holds, REPLICATED, NOT_REPLICATED; FAILED_RUN replaces only a status that reached REPLICATION_INCONCLUSIVE's step; entries are keyed by descriptor, and the level subject has none
replication.local_artifact_records: written only when a comparable descriptor reached step 3 of status_rule: statuses, every descriptor's status and reason; per such descriptor the replication's gates, events, shape ladder, p1, m1 (those computed) and status; and the folder_manifest digest of each folder of leagues whose match index exists (null for an absent folder or index); returned by run_replication and written by the runner in stage serialise; never committed

synthetic_gate.season_seed_rule: base_seed + seed_stride_per_scenario * (position of the scenario in scenarios) + seed_stride_per_overdispersion * (position of the value in overdispersion_grid) + seed_stride_per_season * (season index); the season's generator is default_rng(season seed). The configuration a synthetic season's evaluation reads is this config with exactly two keys replaced: seed by the season seed and bootstrap_replicates by synthetic_gate.bootstrap_replicates; every other key, leagues, unexposed_leagues and every gate minimum included, is read unchanged. The strides keep every season seed, and the engine streams seed + seed_streams of every season, distinct
synthetic_gate.league_rule: one synthetic league per entry of leagues, in that order and under that name, with expected_teams_per_league teams
synthetic_gate.schedule_rule: Berger tables: for n teams, the last team is fixed and the others rotate one place each round; in round r the fixed team's pair is (the first rotating team, fixed) if r is even and reversed if odd; the other pairs (rotating[i], rotating[n - 1 - i]) for i = 1 .. n/2 - 1, home first if i is odd and reversed if even; rounds n - 1 .. 2n - 3 repeat rounds 0 .. n - 2 with venues swapped
synthetic_gate.league_composition_source: not recorded by the designer; the reviser could not establish it (preregistration.md, prior exposure)
synthetic_gate.coordinate_rule: sd_side and sd_width are standard deviations of the defender effect on log-ratio coordinates z1 and z2; at league_composition a shift of 0.15 moves a channel share by about four percentage points (3.9 on z1, 3.6 on z2)

strength_shape_rules.latent_tercile: f = +1, 0, -1 for the top, middle and bottom latent-strength tercile (descending latent strength s_t, tercile = (strength_tercile_count * position) // T), standardised within league (minus the league mean, divided by the population standard deviation, ddof 0; latent_tercile_code of PIPELINE section 5); delta_t += strength_shape * f * (+1, -1) on (z1, z2)
strength_shape_rules.measured_points: f = full-season points per match from the season's goals, which are drawn before the team terms (PIPELINE section 5), standardised within league (minus the league mean, divided by the population standard deviation, ddof 0; points_per_match_code of PIPELINE section 5); delta_t += strength_shape * f * (+1, -1) on (z1, z2)

secondary_laws.source: invented round values written for the gate on 14 October 2026; read from no corpus
secondary_laws.rule: conceded_f3_entries_wide_share is formed from the primary's counts; each other secondary draws its own counts with the primary's attacker, overdispersion and level laws and no defender term; for a two-part secondary every two-dimensional term is replaced by a one-dimensional draw with the same standard deviation, and home_shape_attacker by its first component

design_effect.rule: Var(n . w) / E[N] at each overdispersion value over the same at sd_match_shape 0, with w = -ln(q_shifted / q_league) per part; rows drawn from the generator law with default_rng(design_effect.seed)

frame_negative_control.rule: with the defender-frame mirror removed, the planted side effect is recovered with the opposite sign
frame_negative_control.statistic: team 0's side-balance coordinate (the first basis row of the primary, Python index 0 of log_ratio_basis(3), [s, 0, -s]; log_ratio_smoothing_per_part per part, pooled counts of its valid rows as defender) minus the mean of the other teams' same coordinate
frame_negative_control.passed: the statistic is above zero read through the descriptor (def_left reads att_right) and below zero when att_left is read as def_left

results_strings.interpretation: Aggregate test of whether a defending team's own history adds out-of-sample information about the composition of what it concedes; no team is named or ordered.
results_strings.uncertainty_limit: Calendar-week intervals condition on the selected constants and on the post-kick-off window; selection uncertainty and dependence across weeks within a team are omitted. A third of the evaluation rows were scored before for a different conceded target.
results_strings.product_effect: Opponent Lab may show a descriptor as a tested tendency of one season, behind an opt-in, only under an established token; under every other token the panel shows the prior-date record only. No requirement, optimiser weight or ordering of teams changes.
results_strings.identity_stress_note: Teams are permuted within league and strength tercile; this is a stress diagnostic, not an exchangeable permutation test and not a p-value.
results_strings.data_license: Public Pappalardo/Wyscout CC BY 4.0; the replication arm's results are not in this file: they are reported in analysis.md only.
results_strings.reuse_disclosure: E-07 and E-08 scored a third of these evaluation rows for a conceded level of xT; before registration no descriptor of this protocol was computed by team on this corpus, except, if E-11 ran first, its per team-match counts on 36 double-coded matches, which the registration commit states.

forbidden_result_substrings_scope: the exact text json.dumps(payload, indent=1, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) of the payload with the single key provenance.config removed; the key-name rules and banned_key_paths read the whole payload, echo included
hash_policy: sha256 over LF-normalised bytes for protocol, config, pipeline document, vectors and source files; content hashes for data frames
